title: The Dial Comes To Town
summary: A 1940 Bell Telephone educational short teaching customers how to use their new dial phones and why the change was happening. It is a period piece about rolling out a new technology to ordinary people.
why: Cited as a charming example of the effort once made to teach the public a new technology, in threads about phones and teaching seniors.

quote.text: here is a 1940 educational movie by Bell Telephone they made to teach customers about this new technology
